reason: Round 4 observed ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED on external fonts and CDN hosts. It is the same sandbox network block as ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID, not a product error, and E.5 names only the second code.

changes.before: any error other than the sandbox's `ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID` for an external resource is a failure.
changes.after: any error other than the sandbox's `ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID` or `ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED` for an external resource (a host that is not the app's own origin) is a failure.
changes.tracesTo: definition.json testConstraints (sandboxed browser, external hosts blocked by the proxy); docs/test-results/chart-gallery/round-1.md, round-2.md, round-4.md (both codes seen on Google Fonts and cdnjs three.js)
changes.whyNeeded: The sandbox blocks external hosts with either code; the step must name both to be unambiguous and deterministic.

checklist.Exact: pass (two exact error codes and an explicit definition of external)
checklist.Reachable: pass (console check on desktop and mobile)
